item.title: Deal on air passenger rights: MEPs secure improved traveller protection
item.description: Negotiators reached a provisional agreement on new rules that will be binding from 2027. Students and young travellers using budget airlines will see compensation thresholds change. The deal was criticised by consumer campaigners as watered down.

item.title: Commission proposes first-ever EU rules on age verification for social media
item.description: The Commission unveiled a proposal that would require very large online platforms to verify the age of users. The mandatory scheme would apply to TikTok and Instagram and carry fines of up to 6 percent of global turnover. Digital rights campaigners warned it amounts to surveillance.

item.title: Media advisory - General Affairs Council of 16 September 2026
Council adopts new sanctions package targeting shadow fleet
item.description: The Council today adopted a package that freezes assets and bans port access. It enters into force tomorrow. Hungary had vetoed an earlier draft.
